summary: ActivityMocker bypasses the worker's activity-running signal, causing the virtual test clock to skip through start-to-close timeouts before mocked responses arrive. This makes timer-driven workflows with mocked activities effectively untestable under time-skipping.
userImpact: Users cannot test timer-driven workflows with mocked activities under time-skipping, making such workflows untestable in the PHP SDK.
rootCause: ActivityMocker sits outside the worker's activity-running signal, preventing the test server from knowing an activity is in flight and thus causing it to fast-forward virtual time. Other SDKs (TS, Java, Go) register test mocks as real activity implementations so the test server correctly pauses the virtual clock.
keyQuote: The root cause is that ActivityMocker sits outside the worker's "activity is running" signal.
